attributes.name: menu toggle element type
attributes.definition: Whether the navigation menu toggle is implemented as a real button element or something else.

values.definition: Menu toggle is a native button element.
Toggle is not a button or the element type is not stated.

attributes.name: menu toggle visual treatment
attributes.definition: How the menu toggle button looks.

values.definition: Toggle is a text-labelled button with rounded corners (and possibly padding).
Toggle is an icon without text label.

attributes.name: ARIA usage level
attributes.definition: Extent to which ARIA attributes are used on the page.

values.definition: ARIA attributes used for accessibility, extent not specified.
ARIA used heavily across interactive elements such as dialogs and menus.

attributes.name: menu toggle responsive visibility
attributes.definition: Whether the menu toggle is shown only at certain viewport widths.

values.definition: Shown on small screens, hidden at desktop width.
